Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas, involving two vehicles. Driver 1 was
operating the northbound vehicle and stated that Driver 2's southbound vehicle crossed into the lane and made
contact at low speed. Driver 1 reported a knee injury, and the mechanism of the impact and the force involved are
consistent with that type of injury. Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, a fact
confirmed by responding officers and by the account given at the scene. Photographs taken at the scene show
damage to the front end of both vehicles that corresponds to the described impact. No independent witnesses were
located, so the account rests on the statements of those involved and on the physical evidence. A few older scratches
were noted on the lower bumper of Driver 1's vehicle, and these may predate this collision. Driver 1 is listed as a
named driver on the insurance policy covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene, and the report will
be forwarded for supplemental review.
</page>
